thread:
kai: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — need owners for statuspage copy, customer summary, RCA sharing policy, and recurrence analysis. Keep replies short so CS can watch this thread.

alex: I can take statuspage + short customer blurb. Will post consumer and enterprise variants by EOD.

mira: I'll own the RCA-sharing policy. Proposal: publish a short public summary within 48h, full sanitized RCA within 7 days, and only share logs when customers opt in. I'll draft redaction rules.

kai: Sounds good. Ops: please create tickets and remind owners at 48h.

ops-bot: Created tickets: INC-12001 (statuspage + blurb) -> alex, due 2026-06-10; INC-12002 (RCA policy + consent checkbox) -> mira, due 2026-06-08; INC-12003 (recurrence 90-day trend) -> lucas, due 2026-06-15. Reminder scheduled in 48h.

lucas: I'll run the 90-day trend analysis and flag accounts with repeated KV hits. Deliverable: short deck + recommended next steps.

alex: Draft status copy posted: "We experienced intermittent write latency affecting a few customers. Mitigations were applied to reduce impact and we are investigating. A full incident report will be posted within 7 days." Mira/legal: please review enterprise variant.

mira: Adding redaction checklist to the policy: remove customer IDs, IPs, internal hostnames, and exact customer-linked timestamps. Keep anonymized timelines and aggregate metrics. Consent mock: "I authorize Redwood to share sanitized logs for troubleshooting."

kai: If owners miss deadlines, ops posts the interim summary and statuspage link; owners continue the RCA. Agreed?

alex: Agreed. I'll coordinate with CS to publish interim note if needed.

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up ping at 2026-06-08T09:00Z if tickets still open.

[end of thread]
